गणना:

\n\n

टैंक की कुल क्षमता, (63,140) का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य = 1260 

\n\n

8 प्रवेशिका पाइपों की दक्षता = (1260/140) × 8

\n\n

= 72 लीटर/मिनट

\n\n

y निकासी पाइपों की दक्षता = (1260/63) × y

\n\n

= 20y लीटर/मिनट

\n\n

कुल लिया गया समय = (1260)/(72 - 20y) = 105

\n\n

⇒ 1260 = 7560 - 2100y

\n\n

⇒ 6300 =  2100y

\n\n

⇒ y = 3

\n\n

∴ उत्तर 3 है।

Concept to be used:

\n\n

Distance = Speed × Time

\n\n

Solution:

\n\n

\n\n

Remaining distance to be covered = Total distance - Distance covered in first 25 min

\n\n

⇒ 90000 m - 22800 m = 67200 metres

\n\n

Remaining time = Total time - Time spent in first 25 min

\n\n

⇒ 3600 s - 1500 s = 2100 seconds

गणना

\n\n

IIT बंर्बइ और IIT मद्रास में छात्रों की संख्या = 2080 - (430 + 350 + 400)

\n\n

⇒ 2080 - 1180

\n\n

⇒ 900

\n\n

माना कि IIT मद्रास में छात्रों की संख्या 5a है।

\n\n

IIT बंर्बइ में छात्रों की संख्या = 5a - 5a × 20%

\n\n

⇒  4a

\n\n

⇒ 9a = 900

\n\n

⇒ a = 100

\n\n

4a → 400

\n\n

IIT बंर्बइ में छात्रों की संख्या 400 है।

\n16d:Tb2a,\n

Given :

\n\n

Given data:

\n\n

Total distance = 90 km = 90000 metres
\nTotal time = 1 hour = 3600 seconds
\nTime spent travelling at 15.2 m/s = 25 minutes = 1500 seconds
\nSpeed during first 25 minutes = 15.2 m/s
\n 

\n\n

Concept to be used:

\n\n

Distance = Speed × Time

\n\n

Solution:

\n\n

Distance covered in first 25 minutes = Speed × Time

\n\n

⇒ 15.2 m/s × 1500 s = 22800 metres

\n\n

Remaining distance to be covered = Total distance - Distance covered in first 25 min

\n\n

⇒ 90000 m - 22800 m = 67200 metres

\n\n

Remaining time = Total time - Time spent in first 25 min

\n\n

⇒ 3600 s - 1500 s = 2100 seconds

\n\n

Speed during remaining time = Remaining distance / Remaining time

\n\n

⇒ 67200 m / 2100 s = 32 m/s

\n\n

Therefore, Jehangir should travel at a speed of 32 m/s for the remaining time to reach his destination on time.

\n", "hn": "

दी गई जानकारी:

\n\n

कुल दूरी = 90 किमी = 90000 मीटर
\nकुल समय = 1 घंटा = 3600 सेकंड
\n15.2 मीटर/सेकंड की गति से यात्रा में व्यतीत समय = 25 मिनट = 1500 सेकंड
\nपहले 25 मिनट के दौरान गति = 15.2 मीटर/सेकेंड

\n\n


\nप्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

दूरी = गति × समय

\n\n

हल:

\n\n

पहले 25 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी = गति × समय

\n\n

⇒ 15.2 मीटर प्रति सेकंड × 1500 सेकंड = 22800 मीटर

\n\n

तय की जाने वाली शेष दूरी = कुल दूरी - पहले 25 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी

\n\n

⇒ 90000 मीटर - 22800 मीटर = 67200 मीटर

\n\n

शेष समय = कुल समय - पहले 25 मिनट में व्यतीत किया गया समय

\n\n

⇒ 3600 सेकंड - 1500 सेकंड = 2100 सेकंड

\n\n

शेष समय में गति = शेष दूरी/शेष समय

\n\n

⇒ 67200 मीटर/2100 सेकेंड = 32 मीटर/सेकेंड

\n\n

इसलिए, जहांगीर को समय पर अपने गंतव्य तक पहुँचने के लिए शेष समय के लिए 32 मीटर/सेकेंड की गति से यात्रा करनी चाहिए।

    Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

    \n\n

    The little boy called up his best friend on his birthday.

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "His best friend has been called up by the little boy on his birthday."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "His best friend was called up by the little boy on his birthday.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "His best friend is called up by the little boy on his birthday.&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "His best friend was being called up by the little boy on his birthday."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is "His best friend was called up by the little boy on his birthday."
    \n
    \nKey Points \n
      \n\t
    • In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
      • \n\t
    • The passive sentence is formed using the auxiliary verb "to be" + past participle of the main verb.
      • \n\t
    • In this sentence, "his best friend" is the object of the active sentence, so it becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
      • \n\t
    • "Called up" is the main verb, and its past participle form is "called up."
      • \n\t
    • Therefore, the correct passive sentence is:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • "His best friend was called up by the little boy on his birthday."
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n
    \n\n

    Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

    \n\n

    Additional Information

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Option 1: "His best friend has been called up by the little boy on his birthday." This is also in passive voice, but the use of "has been" instead of "was" is incorrect because the action happened in the past, not the present perfect.
      • \n\t
    • Option 3: "His best friend is called up by the little boy on his birthday." This is in present tense, not past tense, so it is not correct for this sentence.
      • \n\t
    • Option 4: "His best friend was being called up by the little boy on his birthday." This is in passive voice, but the use of "being" implies that the action was ongoing or in progress, which is not specified in the original sentence.
      • \n

    The correct answer is "Misanthrope."

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t

        \n\t\t

        \n\t\t
        • \n\t\t

        \n\t\t

        \n\t\t

    Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

    \n\n

    Who stole my tickets? 

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "My tickets was stolen by whom?"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "My tickets got stolen by who?"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "By whom were my tickets stolen?"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "My tickets were stolen by who?"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is "By whom were my tickets stolen?"

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The sentence is in the active voice with the subject "who" performing the action of stealing.
      • \n\t
    • To convert it into passive voice, the object "my tickets" becomes the subject and the verb "stole" is changed to its past participle form "stolen."
      • \n\t
    • The doer of the action, "who," is now introduced with the preposition "by" as the agent of the passive sentence.
      • \n\t
    • The passive sentence structure is "object + auxiliary verb (be) + past participle verb + by + agent."
      • \n\t
    • Thus, the correct statement would be:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • By whom were my tickets stolen?
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n
    \n\n

    Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

    \n\n

    Additional Information 

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Option 1, "My tickets was stolen by whom?" is incorrect because the verb "was" does not agree with the subject "tickets" which is plural.
      • \n\t
    • Option 2, "My tickets got stolen by who?" is incorrect because it uses the colloquial expression "got stolen" instead of the correct passive form "were stolen."
      • \n\t
    • Option 4, "My tickets were stolen by who?" is grammatically correct but does not use the passive voice correctly as it does not invert the subject-object relationship.
      • \n
